name: yocto-recipe-debugger
description: Shows what BitBake really does with your recipe: unused :append, overwritten values, final values.

yoctoRecipeDebugger.buildDir.markdownDescription: BitBake build directory (the one with `conf/local.conf`). `${workspaceFolder}` is replaced.

yoctoRecipeDebugger.initScript.markdownDescription: Path to `oe-init-build-env`. Empty: search next to the build directory.

yoctoRecipeDebugger.commandWrapper.markdownDescription: Command prefix that enters a build host where BitBake works, for example `docker run --rm -i -v /work:/work my-yocto-image`. Paths must be the same inside and outside. Empty: run on this machine.

yoctoRecipeDebugger.python.markdownDescription: Python 3.9+ used to run the language server on this machine (not BitBake).

scripts.vendor: rm -rf server && mkdir -p server && mkdir -p server/src && cp -r ../../src/yocto_recipe_debugger server/src/ && uv pip install --quiet --target server/lib 'pygls>=2.0,<3' && find server -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.package: npm run vendor && npm run compile && vsce package --allow-missing-repository
